notes.title: [Community News] June 2025 Stage Jam: SHIBA GAME FEST
notes.content:

HUMANITY Stage Jams invite our community of USER STAGES designers to craft new levels based on a central theme. For June 2025, the theme is SHIBA GAME FEST, a celebration of video games and gaming culture! We are encouraging our creators to create homage stages to their favorite gaming franchises or use HUMANITY’s mechanics to make games-within-a-game. You can take this theme in any direction you want! Stage creators of all skill levels are welcome to participate, and if you’re just a player, keep your eyes peeled for a STAGE JAM playlist within USER STAGES highlighting stages made as part of the theme!

Creators can take this theme in any direction they’d like. To highlight the theme even more, we’ll play these stages during our HUMANITY Hub Community Stream in May. Follow our Twitch channel at https://www.twitch.tv/EnhanceExperience to be notified when we go live.

Join the Enhance Discord server at https://discord.gg/enhance, and share your creations in the #create-and-share channel. Discuss stage creation ideas, learn more about creating stages, or play stages together.

notes.title: [Community News] The 2024 Second Annual Goldy Awards Are On Now
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43695402/590b2b9e1138a6e334be69102f9726e5d9ff46f6.png

Today kicks off the 2024 Second Annual Goldy Awards, an event showcasing the best community-made content in HUMANITY. We’ve put together a collection of over 100 stages across 11 different categories. Play the game, rate and favorite your picks, and help us celebrate these fantastic creations. This year, the community will vote for BEST PUZZLE GAME by voting here. A combination of gameplay data and selection by the Enhance Community Team will determine the remaining categories. The creators of the winning entries will receive a physical Shiba and Goldy figure set!

CATEGORIES
The 2024 categories are:

BEST PUZZLE STAGE
BEST FOLLOW STAGE
BEST PLATFORMING STAGE
BEST HOMAGE / ADAPTATION
BEST OTHERS STAGE
BEST DIFFICULT STAGE
MOST INNOVATIVE STAGE
ACHIEVEMENT IN ARTISTIC DESIGN
BEST CREATOR SEQUENCE(S)
BREAKTHROUGH CREATOR
CREATOR(S) OF THE YEAR

A complete playlist of all the nominated stages is available in-game (PLAY STAGES from the title screen) and can be played like its own campaign. Category playlists will rotate in and out between now and the end of January 2025.

Nominees and finalists are determined through gameplay data (players, favorites, ratings, etc.) and Enhance Community Team selection. BEST PUZZLE STAGE will be determined by community votes here.

Winning stages will be announced via the HUMANITY Hub Community Stream at twitch.tv/EnhanceExperience (time/date TBD). Winning creators must contact Enhance at support@enhance-experience.com and confirm their identity by March 1, 2025 to receive a physical award.

==================================
ELIGIBILITY
The Enhance Community Team / Goldy Awards committee considered and determined the shortlist of stages per category from the available playable stages as of November 31, 2024. If a nominated stage is removed, edited, or altered in any way, it may no longer be eligible.

JUDGING & VOTING
Starting December 20, 2024, players will be able to vote for BEST PUZZLE STAGE via https://forms.gle/Cusdhszft6UYdKCJ9. Winners for other categories will be determined through gameplay data (players, favorites, ratings, etc.) and Enhance Community Team selection.

WINNERS
Winning stages will be announced via stream (time/date TBD) at twitch.tv/EnhanceExperience. Winning creators must contact Enhance at support@enhance-experience.com and confirm their identity by March 1, 2025 to receive a physical award.

PRIZES
A set of 1 Shiba and 1 Goldy statue with the winner’s stage and category etched into it and a customized thank you card.

Good luck to all the nominated creators!

notes.title: HUMANITY Community News Vol. 2
notes.content:
Hey, welcome to the second volume of our Community News. This week was big for us as we hit 1 million downloads across PS5, PS4, and Steam. 

Thanks to all who are playing and enjoying HUMANITY—we appreciate you! Keep spreading the word about the game, and be sure to join our Discord community.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43695402/aeb2ad578f14ffae1c18f88245862174b9fe8ec4.png

Recapping the HUMANITY Hub stream

ICYMI, you can watch the VOD of our community stream below. We welcomed the hosts of The Bonus Points to the stream, talked about their YouTube channel and podcast (which you should subscribe to if you're not), played through the levels they've created, and made a coin-pusher stage together. In-game, there's a playlist with the levels we looked at during the stream. Hop into USER STAGES now and check it out!

[previewyoutube=UDFISMHLXPk;full][/previewyoutube]

Here are three must-play stages by Joe and Oli, hosts of The Bonus Points:

REGROW
STAGE ID: 121-561-3978
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43695402/d8955043e8a7ce1f465c0271f04e8272c7ea10bb.jpg

FETCH
STAGE ID: 145-788-1455
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43695402/2064f82feeaa22326f6ef868478639ba6c629109.jpg

ONE BLOCK WIDE
STAGE ID: 058-417-2969
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43695402/cfe265971d572662c79745c1c1aca93cb1c53fd6.jpg

The HUMANITY Hub community stream is live every Wednesday. Next week we'll dive further into the STORY MODE and community-made stages. Stay tuned to our X account or your newsfeed on PlayStation and Steam to find out when we're going live.

Next Discord Creator Workshop: SPRAWLING

This next Creator Workshop theme is SPRAWLING—stages that are large in scope. Maybe it's multiple small puzzles or one big set piece, we're looking levels that stretch the boundaries of creating in HUMANITY.  Be sure to tag your stage with "SPRAWLING" to participate, and join our Discord community at discord.gg/Enhance and share your creations with us!

People-Pathing Pointers

Ah yes, the flow of HUMANITY. People walk out of a gate, and you must deal with their numbers (at least in most stages)! Pathing these hordes can prove tricky in some situations. Here are some pro people-pathing pointers for these precarious predicaments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43695402/1236855883b7ad610ebc8b16c928497c44d7e84c.jpg

Let's say you must keep a People Switch activated while pathing humans elsewhere. Creating a loop of humans over the switch will ensure it stays activated. Note the more people that flow into a circle, the more likely it is to become so crowded it overflows, with humans straying in all directions. Try not to let that happen! (Unless you want to on purpose—we'll discuss "Overflow" in a future post.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43695402/3bb1445b6837862f9dd4abff08c9b2260f9d0adc.jpg

If you don't have the surface area for a complete circle, you can still make them walk back and forth. However, even with a smaller group, you may find that as humans collide, they'll randomly stray off the path, so this method is much less reliable than looping them. Their numbers may eventually not be enough to keep a switch active.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43695402/202cb0a211bc45e178b2d79fb7af02562256796e.jpg

Maybe you're moving a lot of Pushable Blocks amongst intersecting paths of humans. Segmenting a group of 5-10 humans away from an always-marching flow can help. Send the rest off the edge of the stage (temporarily!) and you should have enough room to work! You need at least five people to push a Pushable Block. This is especially handy on a stage like Sequence 2's THE WALL where space is limited and you don't want to chance a rogue stream of humans ruining the positions of your Pushable Blocks.

And that's it for this installment of HUMANITY Community News! Join us on Wednesdays every week for our HUMANITY Hub Community Streams. Live on Twitch, YouTube, and Steam, or check our YouTube channel for the VODs afterward.

[previewyoutube=u60yIiqfbyU;full][/previewyoutube]

Over 5,000 Stages Uploaded

In addition to HUMANITY's STORY MODE, there's an ever-growing library of USER STAGES. And we just reached a milestone there: Community members have uploaded five THOUSAND stages. That's an amazing number that continues to increase as more and more players discover HUMANITY.

The First To 99

Congratulations to knighting, the first of our community members to reach the maximum Player Level. In HUMANITY's USER STAGES, you gain XP as you play and finish stages. You get more XP for completing more difficult ones and collecting Goldy, and the XP threshold required to get to the next level increases as you advance. 

By the numbers, that’s...

4,131 user stages played
2,447 stages with all Goldy collected
Over 500 hours played
400,000 XP required for max level

For those of you yet to jump into the USER STAGES community, knighting has this to say to you: “There’s a lot of fun, difficult puzzles in USER STAGES. Try checking out the Top Favorites playlist to get a good sample of what you can find, and maybe search for top-rated with some tags of what you liked from STORY MODE.”

On Our Discord: The Creator Workshop!

JEMAPUR is a wave addict, electronic musician, sound designer and coder.

His method? By using modular synthesizers to create phenomena as sound ecosystems that continue to transform in time in space.

JEMAPUR has composed music for a number of films and exhibitions, including the documentary film “Tower of the Sun” (2018) and the month-long exhibition “RESONANCE: Synesthesia + Feedback” in 2019 at De School in Amsterdam with the sculptor Victoria Galvani.
